property_summary: A caller is paid 2 ether by settle() if and only if their locked guess equals keccak256(blockhash(targetBlock)); the mutant inverts this and pays exactly when the guess is wrong, which for any wrong guess (e.g. g != keccak256(bytes32(0))) violates the payout-only-on-correct rule.
change_summary: Invert the win condition so that a wrong guess pays out and a correct guess does not.
